about_the_game:
The adventure begins when Capt. Gore Rapture and crew are called to the Planet Goatainn. The reason is that the evil on this planet is affecting the entire solar system. Their mission is to neutralize all foes on the once Glorious planet. The landing was rough, and the result was that Cpt. Rapture knocked unconscious. The ship's co-pilot puts the Captain on a hypnotic schedule to recall all missions over time as he recovers! This game features large, beautiful, engaging maps with many objectives. The enemies are diverse in skills and breed, with many around every corner. Enjoy the finest sci-fi and old-school weaponry that can dismember even the toughest of these evil folks. 

Gore Rapture ships with all the latest in-game technologies that can be turned off to scale to older systems. This Game features plenty of cool music and can be played in FPP or TPP modes. An enemy mini-map is optional and often available to assess your surroundings and who is around you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad-Core Processor
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 24 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.5 GHz Quad-Core Processor or higher
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
